scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.audio: In 2026, TikTok published a global trend report. The conclusion is only one sentence: the era of impulsive consumption is over.

scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.audio: Current customers, it's not that they don't buy things, they want to first understand one thing: why is this thing worth me spending this money?

scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.audio: Have you met this type of customer? Obviously, there is a demand, a budget, and they also like the product, but they just don't place an order. You think they are waiting for a discount? No, they are waiting for you to give them a reason why it's worthwhile.

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.audio: I once had a guest who chatted three times. Every question was asked. Finally, he told me, 'Tai Xin, I'm not unable to afford it, I just don't know why I should buy it.' This sentence woke me up.

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.audio: From that day on, I no longer communicated with clients about how good my products are or how strong the specifications are. I started asking one question: 'Sir, what do you most hope to solve? If solved, what would your life look like?' Let the customer describe that picture themselves.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: When he sees that picture, he's not buying a product; he's buying for a better version of himself.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: It's like a date. You won't like him just because he treated you to a cheap meal. You will like him because he makes you feel that the time spent with him is meaningful. Clients are not afraid of your trouble; they're afraid you're not worth it.

scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.audio: Clients are not afraid of you showing up; they're afraid you just want to make a deal. I am Tai Xin, helping you understand human nature and close high-value deals. Want to learn more about this logic? Join the sales community to learn more. Link in my bio.
